items.title: SBI Confirms Data Breach – 3000+ Customer Records Exposed on Dark Web
items.description: State Bank of India (SBI) has disclosed a data loss incident after a preliminary review identified 3,897 customer records containing personal information on the dark web. The bank reported the findings in an October 21, 2026, stock exchange filing, while saying investigators still needed to establish the data’s authenticity, completeness, and source. items.description: Meta has paused Muse AI’s conversation sharing feature after a privacy flaw exposed confidential business records and personal details through discoverable chat links. The problem affected pages users chose to share, not every private Muse conversation. Anyone who found an affected link could open its contents without signing in. items.description: OpenAI has expanded its ChatGPT Chrome extension so the assistant can read information across open tabs and carry out browser tasks. The update moves ChatGPT beyond answering questions about a single page, adding tools for comparing content, filling forms, sending messages, and organizing tabs. items.title: WordPress Backup Plugin Developer Hacked to Inject Malicious Code on Installed Sites
items.description: TeamUpdraft, the developer behind the UpdraftPlus WordPress backup plugin, has disclosed a website breach that exposed remote management keys. Attackers used those keys to install malicious plugins on connected WordPress sites, turning a trusted management feature into a route for running harmful code. The company identified unauthorized access to teamupdraft.com during October 17–18, 2026.…

items.title: PHP2Shell: Two Unpatched Critical PHP RCE Flaws (CVSS 9.2) Trigger Emergency Security Alert
items.description: PHP will ship an out-of-cycle security release at 14:00 UTC today, October 21, for two critical vulnerabilities that its security team has rated 9.2 on the CVSS v4.0 scale but has not described. Security researchers at watchTowr say the two flaws allow remote code execution. Only the four supported PHP branches, 8.2 through 8.5, can receive the fix, and no exploitation has been reported so far.
